'''MaxSec Main Access''' was the main roadway that linked the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to the [[Maximum Security Section]]. The [[Tertiary Monitoring Station]] was located along the roadway.
